question: What boon-granting and time-formed aspect of Kālindī is saluted?
premises: Her hands grant boons and fearlessness
Her form is that of time
inference: Kālindī, whose hands grant boons and fearlessness and whose form is time, is saluted.
plain_english: I salute Kālindī, whose hands grant boons and fearlessness and whose form is time.
